capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Audi: Q8 55 e-tron and SQ8 e-tron 114 kWh gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Audi: Q8 55 e-tron and SQ8 e-tron 106 kWh net. Applied to all 2024-2025 Q8/SQ8 ids (US/CA); not checked whether the 89 kWh Q8 50 was sold in North America.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: a Global Battery Alliance battery-passport pilot lists the Audi Belgium 114 kWh pack with Samsung SDI (Hungary) prismatic cells and chemistry NCA. Third-party dataset, not an Audi statement; Audi pages say only "optimized cell chemistry".

dc_max_kw.notes: Audi: 170 kW for the Q8 55 e-tron and SQ8 e-tron (114 kWh pack).

ac_max_kw.notes: US: Audi supplies a 9.6 kW (40 A) J1772 charger (Wikipedia). Europe 11 kW standard (Audi). The 19.2 kW option package exists in the US; 9.6 kW is the base. Canada and 2025 not separately sourced; same equipment assumed (2019-2025 compared).
